title: Eliminate 429 Storm on /api/messages/conversations, Shared Poller Architecture & Rate-Limit Alignment
spec:
### 1. MANDATE & PROBLEM STATEMENT
The User opened https://ime365.local/dashboard and observed 52 repeated red console errors:
'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 429 (Too Many Requests) api/messages/conversations:1'.
The User strictly demands: 'why am i seeing these errors? Ask developer to completely fix the pipeline.'
Mandate: Architect an enterprise-grade fix eliminating the 429 rate limit storm on messaging endpoints, implement a shared singleton/coalesced poller with exponential backoff on the frontend, tune backend rate limiting budgets, and resolve the contrast token regression from DIR-053.

### 2. ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS (RCA)
1. RCA-1 (Uncoordinated Multi-Instance Polling Storm): Multiple dashboard components (CubaCandidateShell.jsx, MessagesNavBadge.jsx, and ProfileDisplay.jsx) each mount an independent instance of useUnreadMessages(). With POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 15000, 3 instances produce 12 req/min = 60 requests in 5 minutes.
2. RCA-2 (Overly Restrictive Global Messaging Rate Limiter): In backend/security/abuse.js, MESSAGING_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT defaults to 30 requests per 5 minutes (6 req/min). Because app.use('/api/messages', messagingAccountLimiter) is mounted globally on all messaging routes, legitimate unread badge polling exhausts the quota in 2.5 minutes.
3. RCA-3 (Absence of Backoff & 429 Circuit Breaker): In src/hooks/useUnreadMessages.js, when an HTTP 429 or network error occurs, setStatus('error') is set, but the 15-second setInterval continues indefinitely. There is zero Retry-After respect and zero exponential backoff, resulting in 52+ repeated 429 errors piling up in the DevTools console.
4. RCA-4 (Unshared In-Flight & Cache Deduplication): apiJson('/api/messages/conversations') lacks in-flight promise reuse and short-term caching across simultaneous component renders.
5. RCA-5 (DIR-023 Amber Token Regression from DIR-053): The reconnect banner classes introduced in CubaCandidateHero.jsx (bg-amber-50/95, border-amber-300/70, dark:text-amber-100/80) trip tests/dir023-contrast-tokens.test.mjs with 3 unmapped opacity classes.

### 3. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION & IMPLEMENTATION STEPS
- S1: Backend Rate Limiter Alignment & Sane Read Budget
  - In backend/security/abuse.js and backend/index.js, ensure read-only unread count/conversation polling (/api/messages/conversations) has a generous, realistic quota (e.g. raise MESSAGING_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT to at least 150 or separate heavy mutation endpoints from passive badge reads) so legitimate polling never hits 429.
- S2: Shared Singleton Poller / Coalescing in useUnreadMessages.js
  - Upgrade useUnreadMessages.js or platform.js to use an in-memory shared singleton subscriber / module-level broadcast pattern. Regardless of how many components mount useUnreadMessages(), exactly ONE network poll is dispatched per interval.
- S3: Dynamic Backoff & Retry-After Circuit Breaker
  - In useUnreadMessages.js, catch 429 status and network errors. When rate-limited or in error state, back off dynamically (15s -> 30s -> 60s) or pause until Retry-After expires, completely eliminating console error storms. Reset to 15s upon successful response.
- S4: Fix DIR-023 Amber Token Mapping
  - In src/components/cuba/CubaCandidateHero.jsx or contrast map, ensure reconnect banner classes use compliant Cuba design tokens, resolving the failure in tests/dir023-contrast-tokens.test.mjs.
- S5: Comprehensive E2E Verification & Regression Test Battery
  - Run npm test to verify all 67 tests pass (including contrast tokens and messaging gate tests).
  - Execute a multi-minute polling simulation on https://ime365.local/dashboard to guarantee zero 429 errors and clean badge synchronization.

### 4. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- AC-1: Zero 429 Too Many Requests errors on /api/messages/conversations during continuous dashboard usage.
- AC-2: useUnreadMessages() coalesces multiple mounted instances into a single coordinated network read.
- AC-3: If any transient 429 or transport error occurs, the frontend gracefully backs off and halts spamming.
- AC-4: tests/dir023-contrast-tokens.test.mjs passes 100% (67/67 tests green in npm test).
- AC-5: Production dist is cleanly rebuilt and verified via Playwright DOM crawl with 0 console errors.

plan.summary: DIR-054 FORENSIC RCA VALIDATED AGAINST SOURCE (measured, not assumed). RCA-1 CONFIRMED AND AMPLIFIED: FOUR independent hook instances mount, not three - CubaCandidateShell.jsx:170, MessagesNavBadge.jsx:74, ProfileDisplay.jsx:34, EmployerSidebar.jsx:194. At POLL_INTERVAL_MS=15000 that is 16 req/min = 80 requests per 5-minute window against a 30-request budget, so the quota is exhausted in about 1.9 minutes and every later tick 429s - exactly the 52-error console storm the User reported. RCA-2 CONFIRMED: backend/security/abuse.js:132-136 declares MESSAGING_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT default 30 over windowMs 300000, and backend/index.js:554 mounts it globally on all of /api/messages, so GET badge reads share one budget with POST mutations. generalApiLimiter (120/min, index.js:482-485) is NOT the binding constraint. RCA-3 CONFIRMED: useUnreadMessages.js:99 uses a fixed setInterval(refresh, POLL_INTERVAL_MS) and the catch at :64-68 only sets status error, so the timer keeps firing forever with zero Retry-After respect and zero backoff. RCA-4 CONFIRMED: apiJson (platform.js:170-191) issues a bare fetch with cache no-store, no in-flight promise reuse and no TTL - unlike the proven fetchPublicConfig precedent (platform.js:150-168: publicConfigInFlight + PUBLIC_CONFIG_TTL_MS=15000 snapshot) which should be mirrored. RCA-5 CONFIRMED WITH EXACT EVIDENCE: node --test tests/dir023-contrast-tokens.test.mjs yields 14 pass / 1 FAIL - unmapped light-shade opacity classes: bg-amber-50/95, border-amber-300/70, dark:text-amber-100/80 - all three originating from the DIR-053 reconnect banner at src/components/Candidate/CubaCandidateHero.jsx:201 and :206. CORRECTION TO THE SPEC: the directive names src/components/cuba/CubaCandidateHero.jsx, which DOES NOT EXIST; the real file is src/components/Candidate/CubaCandidateHero.jsx. CONSTRAINTS THAT MUST SURVIVE: tests/messaging-module-gate.test.mjs:112 pins /POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 15000/, :113 pins addEventListener focus refresh, :101 pins the exact returned object shape, :105 pins data totalUnread, :108/:109 pin the fail-visible error path, :116-120 pin resolveMessagesVisibility and setModuleEnabled(false), :123 forbids conf/fire. cuba-tokens.css (2591 lines) currently contains ZERO dark:-prefixed doubled selectors, so inventing one is riskier than reusing already-mapped classes. PLAN: S1 split the coarse messaging limiter into a generous READ tier (namespace messaging-read, MESSAGING_READ_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT default 300 per 5 min = 60/min, 3.75x headroom over the post-S2 worst case of 16/min, failClosed false per the publicBrowse/generalApi coarse-tier precedent) applied only to GET/HEAD on /api/messages/conversations, plus the mutation tier raised from 30 to 150 per spec S1 while KEEPING failClosed true because a mutation budget must stay fail-closed; register both env keys in backend/services/platformConfiguration.js around line 150; preserve the DIR-026 module gate ordering at index.js:571 and the post-requireAuth mount. S2 convert useUnreadMessages.js into a module-level singleton store (subscribers Set + shared snapshot + inflight promise + lastFetchedAt) so exactly ONE interval and ONE network read exist no matter how many components mount, keeping the literal POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 15000, the window focus listener, and the exact returned contract; every consumer reads the same snapshot so all four call sites stay identical and truthful. S3 replace the fixed interval with a self-scheduling setTimeout loop and a Retry-After circuit breaker - extend apiJson ADDITIVELY to attach err.retryAfter from the response Retry-After header (response headers are currently discarded at platform.js:182-189) - with exponential backoff 15s to 30s to 60s to 120s to 240s capped at 300s, resetting to 15s on any success, and logging the outage transition ONCE instead of per tick. S4 fix the contrast regression at the component, which is the option the spec authorises, by using already-mapped classes: bg-amber-50/95 to bg-amber-50/90 (mapped at cuba-tokens.css:1941), border-amber-300/70 to border-amber-300/80 (mapped at cuba-tokens.css:2203), and dark:text-amber-100/80 to the bare dark:text-amber-100. Deliberately NOT adding new !important maps, because a doubled-selector !important rule for bg-amber-50/95 or border-amber-300/70 would beat the banner own dark:bg-amber-500/10 and dark:border-amber-400/40 overrides and re-create the very pastel-island defect DIR-023 exists to prevent. Net result: 15/15 green with ZERO CSS churn. S5 verification: npm run test:security:static, npm run lint, npm test, npm run build under the 4.0s budget, a new regression suite pinning single-interval coalescing, the backoff ladder, Retry-After honouring and the 300/150 defaults, and a live XAMPP-served Playwright capture of https://ime365.local/dashboard for at least 6 continuous minutes asserting 0 x 429 on /api/messages/conversations, exactly one request per 15s tick, 0 console errors and clean badge sync, then bridge dev submit-evidence. All servers strictly via XAMPP; no detached background server processes.
steps: S1 backend/security/abuse.js - add messagingReadAccountLimiter (namespace messaging-read, MESSAGING_READ_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT default 300 per 5min, failClosed false) and raise messagingAccountLimiter default 30 to 150 (failClosed true stays)
S2 backend/services/platformConfiguration.js - register MESSAGING_READ_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT alongside MESSAGING_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT so the admin panel can tune both

S3 backend/index.js line 554 - replace the blanket app.use /api/messages messagingAccountLimiter mount with a method-aware dispatcher routing GET/HEAD to messagingReadAccountLimiter and all other methods to messagingAccountLimiter, keeping the DIR-026 module gate at line 571 after it and after requireAuth
S4 src/services/api/platform.js apiJson - additively attach err.retryAfter from the Retry-After response header, no change to existing callers

S5 src/hooks/useUnreadMessages.js - extract a module-level singleton store (subscribers Set, shared snapshot, inflight promise, lastFetchedAt) with exactly one refcounted scheduler shared by all consumers, preserving POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 15000, the window focus listener and the returned { unreadCount, error, status, enabled, refresh } object

S6 src/hooks/useUnreadMessages.js - replace setInterval with a self-scheduling setTimeout loop implementing exponential backoff 15s/30s/60s/120s/240s capped at 300s, honouring Retry-After on 429 and 503, resetting to 15s on success and logging the outage transition once
S7 src/components/Candidate/CubaCandidateHero.jsx lines 201 and 206 - swap bg-amber-50/95 to bg-amber-50/90, border-amber-300/70 to border-amber-300/80, dark:text-amber-100/80 to dark:text-amber-100
S8 add regression tests covering poller coalescing, the backoff ladder, Retry-After honouring and the read/mutation limiter split
S9 run npm run test:security:static, npm run lint, npm test, npm run build
S10 live XAMPP Playwright 6-minute dashboard poll capture asserting 0 x 429 and 0 console errors, saved under .bridge/evidence/

evidence.summary: DIR-054 COMPLETE. RCA reproduced live then eliminated. (1) Backend: /api/messages is now METHOD-AWARE - GET/HEAD draw on a new messaging-read budget (MESSAGING_READ_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT default 300/5min, failClosed:false) while POST/PATCH/DELETE keep the mutation budget (MESSAGING_FIVE_MINUTE_LIMIT raised 30 to 150, still failClosed:true); both registered in platformConfiguration.js. LIVE DIFFERENTIAL: pre-fix 35 reads = 10x200 + 25x429 with RateLimit-Limit 30; post-fix 150 reads = 150x200, 0x429, RateLimit-Limit 300. (2) Frontend: new src/hooks/unreadMessagesPoller.js is a React-free SINGLETON scheduler shared by all consumers - one in-flight read, one shared snapshot, exponential ladder 15/30/60/120/240 capped 300s, Retry-After honoured as a floor, refresh() cannot jump the deadline, last-unsubscribe clears the timer. useUnreadMessages.js polls through it and also shares ONE module-flag read per minute (was 4). (3) apiJson additively attaches err.retryAfter from the Retry-After header. (4) DIR-023 amber regression fixed at src/components/Candidate/CubaCandidateHero.jsx (note: the directive's src/components/cuba/ path does not exist) by reusing already-mapped classes - dir023-contrast-tokens 15/15, zero new !important maps. GATES: test:security:static 67/67; lint exit 0 (0 errors, 253 warnings = DIR-047 baseline); npm test 1715 tests 0 failures; build 3.38s (<4.0s budget); new 15-test tests/dir054-shared-poller.test.mjs wired into test:product; combined battery 42/42. LIVE S10: 6.5 continuous minutes on https://ime365.local/dashboard as a real Firebase identity (enableMessagesModule=true, revision 58) = 26 requests for 26 expected ticks, ALL 200, ZERO 429, cadence min 15320/mean 15495ms, ZERO bursts (the old 4-instance signature), badge stable at 'Messages, 0 unread', reconnect banner absent, served chunk assets/useUnreadMessages-DGYs-KZh.js contains the shared poller. HONEST LIMITATION: 4 of the 5 console lines are a PRE-EXISTING non-messaging 404 (GET /api/resumes/<uid> from CubaCandidateShell.jsx:273) plus 1 Stripe telemetry ERR_CONNECTION_RESET - neither is a 429 and neither is in DIR-054 scope; recommend a follow-up directive. INV-1 frozen baseline diff = 0 bytes. All servers via bridge xampp only.
